name: Camp YJ
description_short: Camp YJ is an independent, non-profit Jewish overnight camp in Amherst, New Hampshire, for kids ages 8-15 from a range of Jewish backgrounds.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: Only the homepage was read; 2027 dates and rates are on a separate page (https://campyj.org/2027dates), so no sessions or prices were recorded.

Two addresses listed: the winter office is at 745 High Street, Suite 251, Westwood, MA 02090 (phone (781) 237-9410, after Sept 1), and the camp itself is at 9 Camp Road, Amherst, NH 03031 (phone (603) 673-3710, after June 1). The recorded address is the camp location; the recorded phone is the winter office number, which is the current one as of October.
Footer copyright says 2024, but the page content refers to Summer 2027 registration being open.
Financial aid is inferred only from a 'Grants and Scholarships' menu link.
